reply.text:
I'd steer clear of DMAA. It's a stimulant that has been banned in sports and pulled from the supplement market in a number of countries because of cardiovascular safety concerns, and products that still contain it are the ones cutting corners. That's one to run past a doctor or a dietitian before you ever touch it, and I won't give you an amount of it or any other stimulant.

If you just want more pop in a session, sleep, a meal a couple of hours beforehand, and a warm-up that actually raises your heart rate do more than any tub. I'm happy to look at how your sessions have been feeling and sort out where the energy is going.
